constraints.source_text: A junior and senior recital must be completed under approved faculty supervision and guidance. The faculty of the department of the student's major program determines the detailed requirements of the recitals, including content, length, format and other specifications.
constraints.description: Junior and senior recitals must meet faculty-determined requirements, which are not specified in the catalogue.

constraints.source_text: During the junior and senior years of the program, students develop and fully realize unique individualized, mentored projects related to their work as classical musicians.
constraints.description: Students must complete an individualized, mentored Young Artist Project during junior and senior years.
